cases.note: Netburners 5x5, BN12, streak 88, no cheats, 9-13.5. Lost to two PRE-SENT PASSES on an open board: ply 3 (the AI took the vital 3,2; 3,2 there wins 16/16 replays) and ply 8 (the AI took 0,3). Not the 200ms budget (ply 0's 55-visit 2,2 is what 1600 work plays too) and not a missing objective (Netburners is mirror 'always' with power.on false: objective null by design). A PASS while the AI has not passed is a bet on the AI's seeded reply (golib clockSeed); the ponder prices it at d=1, where the seed is blurred (turnS 0.70 -> 4 +- 5 ticks vs a live cadence of 2-4), and golib.modelRootPasses let it through on a handful of visits ('clearly better', +0.02). 97% of open passes (harness 223/230) are pre-sent. FIX: openPass 'visits' for Netburners (go-solver --open-pass-visits): an open PASS must be the most-visited child; +2.6% [+0.4, +5.0] power/s, 1200 paired. PARTIAL: in some ply-8 reproductions (ponder seeds 4/6) the PASS was the most-visited child (1406/1527 visits, wr 0.57 vs 0,3 at 0.10) and 'visits' would not refuse it. Rejected: 'never' (from ply 9 the only stone 3,0 loses every line and the pass wins 19-3.5), the clock's measured cadence (clockSeed gaps; negative on Daedalus/Illuminati), 'request', 'fresh'.
